rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORbelma
Exhibition name: Helmut Schmidt
rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, before 1977).
Introduced in Australia by Roy H. Rumsey Pty. Ltd. in 1981 as 'Helmut Schmidt'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Mild fragrance. 30 to 40 petals. Large bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 2' to 4' (60 to 120cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
rows.Notes: Zimbabwe patent application No. 8805 on April 25, 1988
